meta.name: CCNL Vigilanza Privata e Servizi Fiduciari FEDERDAT — GPG

sources.notes: Tabelle retributive GPG e SF, 2023-2026. Accordo di rinnovo 04/05/2023 (tranche 01/06/2023) + Ipotesi di accordo 16/02/2024 (tranches 01/06/2024 - 01/12/2026).

notes.text: CCNL HV17 FEDERDAT GPG section. Conglobated, 14 months, divisor 173. 7 levels. 6 tranches: 01/06/2023, 01/06/2024, 01/06/2025, 01/12/2025, 01/04/2026, 01/12/2026. Contract validity: 01/06/2023-31/12/2026.

SENIORITY: pre-July-2026 CCNL (FESICA PDF, CCNL ISTITUTI AZIENDE VIGILANZA PRIVATA, Art. 119) confirmed 5 triennali (cadence 36m, max 5) with per-level amounts: Q=32, I=27, II=24, III=23, IV=22, V=21 EUR/scatto. July 9 2026 renewal (FEDERDAT-CONFIAL) doubled scatti to 10 with "importi maggiorati" — new amounts not found in public sources. Seniority is currently unmodelled (seniority_increment=null for all levels) pending the 2026 amounts.

Apprenticeship: 100% passthrough confirmed from CCNL FEDERDAT Art. 86: "L'Apprendista ha diritto per tutta la durata del periodo di apprendistato all'inquadramento e alla corrispondente retribuzione del livello finale di collocazione." (FESICA PDF, CCNL ISTITUTI AZIENDE VIGILANZA PRIVATA, Art. 86). Engine models this correctly as 100% of destination level salary.
Level VI salary at 01/06/2024 (1185.44) is anomalously high vs prior tranche (1108.06) — confirmed by source as conventional riallineamento for level VI.
